caption:
Give your next task a clear opening: decide what you will do before reaching for your phone.

#focus #attention #habits
scenes:
Before another scroll,
pause for a moment.

What did you mean
to do next?

Put that action
where you can see it.

Give it four minutes
of your attention.
story_text:
Before another scroll,
choose your next action.

text:
Build an exit ramp
for distractions.
caption:
Keep a scrap of paper beside you. Capture distracting ideas there and return to your current task.

#focus #clarity #practice
scenes:
A new idea arrives
while you are working.

Write it down.
You can return later.

Keep your current task
in front of you.

Finish this section.
Then review the list.
story_text:
Capture the distraction.
Return to this section.

caption:
Pause midway through a session and check whether you are still working toward the result you chose.

#reflection #focus #intention
scenes:
Halfway through,
take a brief pause.

Are you still doing
what you came to do?

Choose the next
useful piece.

Continue with
that piece in mind.
story_text:
Halfway check:
What needs attention now?

caption:
Choose one small maintenance task you have postponed. Give it a place in your week before it becomes urgent.

#planning #habits #balance
scenes:
Some progress looks
like maintenance.

Clear the folder.
Update the checklist.

Give a small task
a place this week.

Care for the systems
you already use.
story_text:
Small maintenance
can have a place today.

text:
Choose an ending
before you begin.
caption:
Decide when a work session will end and leave a short handover note for your next session.

#planning #rest #clarity
scenes:
Before you start,
choose an end time.

Work on the task
inside that window.

When the window ends,
write a handover note.

Close the session.
Let the evening begin.
story_text:
Choose an end time.
Leave a handover note.

caption:
Try collecting your materials first, then work with what you have for a short session.

#creativity #focus #practice
scenes:
Still collecting
one more resource?

Gather what you need
for this attempt.

Close the search.
Use what you gathered.

Review the gaps
after you make a draft.
story_text:
Gather enough to try.
Then make a draft.

caption:
Write a short checklist for a task you repeat. Test it once and improve the unclear steps.

#habits #learning #clarity
scenes:
A familiar task
feels messy again.

Write the steps
as you complete them.

Keep the checklist
short and usable.

Test it next time.
Improve one step.
story_text:
Write the steps once.
Improve them next time.

caption:
Move unrelated materials out of your workspace for one session and notice what changes.

#focus #environment #habits
scenes:
Your desk is full.
Your task is specific.

Keep what this
session actually needs.

Move the rest
out of the way.

Try one session.
Notice what changes.
story_text:
Give this task
a little clear space.

text:
Let feedback
be something you use.
caption:
Ask a focused question about your work, then choose one piece of feedback to test.

#learning #growth #practice
scenes:
Ready for feedback?
Ask a clear question.

Which part feels
hard to follow?

Listen for details
you can work with.

Test one adjustment
in your next version.
story_text:
Ask a clear question.
Test one adjustment.

caption:
Keep a short list of low-effort tasks for small gaps in your day. Leave some gaps free for rest.

#planning #balance #intention
scenes:
You have a small gap
before the next thing.

You can rest.
You can do a tiny task.

Choose deliberately.
Leave the rush aside.

Use the gap in a way
that fits today.
story_text:
A small gap can be
space to rest, too.

caption:
Set a limit for research, revisions, or checking before you start. Review whether that limit helped afterward.

#boundaries #clarity #focus
scenes:
Another check?
Another revision?

Choose a limit
before you begin.

Work within it.
Save unresolved notes.

Review the limit
after this attempt.
story_text:
Choose a limit.
Save the remaining notes.

caption:
At the end of a demanding day, choose one simple activity that helps you unwind.

#rest #balance #selfrespect
scenes:
The demanding part
of today is over.

What would help you
unwind this evening?

Choose something
simple and reachable.

Give that choice
some space tonight.
story_text:
The day can end
with a little recovery.
